استأهلت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْهَلْتُ (istaʔhaltu) /is.taʔ.hal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اِسْتَأْهَلْتَ (istaʔhalta) /is.taʔ.hal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اِسْتَأْهَلْتِ (istaʔhalti) /is.taʔ.hal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اِسْتَأْهَلَتْ (istaʔhalat) /is.t
